versions.changelog:
- Removed manual setup requirements — DogearAI account and token are now created automatically on first use.
- Updated documentation to reflect zero-setup experience; token is saved locally, and account can be claimed with email later.
- Added commands for setting and managing API tokens (`set-token`, `login`).
- Clarified instructions and streamlined onboarding; users no longer need to visit dogearai.com to get started.
- Maintenance update: removed legacy `skill-card.md`; added compiled Python file to tracked files.

DogearAI Memory skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the DogearAI Memory skill.
- Enables users to recall and persist long-term personal context across AI tools using DogearAI.
- Requires only a DOGEAR_TOKEN for setup—no extra configuration needed.
- Provides commands to recall context, save memories, list and read memory spaces, and fetch raw memories.
- Designed for seamless use at task start or when capturing durable user preferences, decisions, or project details.
